comments.text: What really stood out to me was the contrast between Istanbul's devastating flood and the quiet moments that make the city memorable. The flooded Grand Bazaar and diverted flights show how quickly extreme weather can disrupt a massive city, yet the ferry, Hagia Sophia, and even a simple coffee beside a street cat reveal a completely different side of Istanbul. Do you think a city's true character is revealed more by its landmarks or by everyday life?
